questiontext.text: Which of the following are primary statutory responsibilities of the Nigeria Immigration Service (NIS)? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Issuing passports, border surveillance, alien control, and anti-trafficking are core NIS duties. Corporate tax collection belongs to the FIRS.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are primary statutory functions of the Nigeria Customs Service (NCS)? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Tariff collection, anti-smuggling, cargo scanning, and enforcing bans are statutory NCS functions. School exams are handled by education ministries.

questiontext.text: Match each agency with its primary statutory domain of responsibility:
